nieuw.titel: Bait compulsory charges just inside maximum range
nieuw.tekst: Place bait just inside the maximum charge range of a frenzied unit, or an impetuous unit that is forced to charge. Aim to give it the greatest possible chance of failing its charge.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that a failed charge delays the enemy's advance.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He placed his bait 15 inches from knights with a stated maximum charge range of 16 inches. The knights failed to reach it.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He warns that if the knights reach and destroy the bait, they can get a free reform, which makes redirection less effective.

bronnen.citaat: move to just inside the maximum charge range

extraCitaten.citaat: you want the biggest possible chance for it to fail the charge

nieuw.titel: Angle compulsory-charge bait away from the centre
nieuw.tekst: Angle bait at least 45 degrees so that the charging unit is drawn to face off the board or away from its centre. Use this to distract powerful enemy units, especially frenzied ones.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that even a failed charger must move towards the bait and orient its facing. A successful charger wheels into contact and aligns with the bait.

bronnen.citaat: and to then angle at 45 degrees

extraCitaten.citaat: away from the center of the board at a minimum
